conclusion.next_runnable_increment: Actual owner-delivered INITIAL finite32 proposal selection with unchanged historical/unloading continuation and actual current-stage guards. This is an online initial planner with guarded execution, not yet a demonstrated rolling state estimator or general bidirectional optimizer.
conclusion.why_not_wait_for_omniscience: A conditional public-model forecast can be used as a heuristic without proving every hidden native state. It must retain its assumptions and uncertainty, and neither its pointwise protection comparison nor its factory token can certify actual protection or permission.
conclusion.what_the_future_fork_adds: The accepted fork shares a conditional MODEL prefix and varies only the not-yet-read later preference. It supplies no evidence that this model prefix equals an actual later native state. Complete action coverage is not hidden-state coverage.

initial_information_assumptions.model_parameters_are_not_authority: The native binary/source identities establish implementation provenance outside selection. They do not reveal remote live state. Model-created protocol IDs are not native request IDs.

dispatch_and_protection.final_local_gate: Before every real submit/no-op decision revalidate the exact current owner, job/tray identity, generation/public traversal, uncommitted suffix/current stage, available source and local receiver information, immutable current action ledger, real wire deadline and accepted session. Native grant/receiving/FIFO/shield remains authoritative. An updated route ACK is not proof of next edge; native_default issues no command and promises no next node.
dispatch_and_protection.forecast_guard: Exact five-job point-prediction nonregression is model_admissible_estimate only. It is not a robust guarantee over unknown states and not native_protection_certified.
dispatch_and_protection.actual_protection: Only complete matched prospective native arms with all5 actual terminal receipts can establish strict observed nonregression. An unfinished job, missing required action or incomplete reference remains unknown. Local revalidation cannot by itself prove future whole-population protection.
dispatch_and_protection.two_owner_agreement: Independent deterministic decisions may agree on normal delivered source facts, but asymmetric readiness remains possible. Do not use an omniscient cross-owner comparison as an online consensus signal. The experiment may record disagreement after the fact. Atomic joint agreement would require a separately specified real proposal/ready/commit exchange; no fake demand IDs or timing signals are allowed.
dispatch_and_protection.timing: All observations, decoding, context construction, full32 computation, source/code checks required by the implementation, output, submits, delivered ACK processing and descendants count. A simulation's fixed physical clock during computation does not certify real-time operation. Keep explicit over100ms/unknown timing outcomes; offline360s conformance is not a new product deadline.

prospective_scope_for_a_later_registrati.status: Design only. Source/pure integration and budget measurement must precede a separate bounded registration/dispatch.
prospective_scope_for_a_later_registrati.reference_scope: New online restricted proposals use the same lawful information and evaluator. Existing complete native16/32 reference families are offline assessment only; their selected indices, timings and outputs never enter a proposal.
prospective_scope_for_a_later_registrati.requested_outcomes: Same-information method selections, current-action executability, all5 endpoints, complete reference-family comparisons, causal initial-R1/R2/later-R1 contribution and complete-request cost; report ordinary MPC/LNS explanations directly. No method novelty claim.

rolling_follow_on.current_gap: A later SuppliedContext is not a Markov restart state: complete hidden headway/calendar/FIFO history, arbitration tie order, peer pending/reply/quiet policy state and unseen immutable action payloads are not all supplied. A retained initial-model point remains a conditional estimate.
rolling_follow_on.strict_future_filter: The next small module can construct an evidence-constrained relation between opaque actual request/message identities and projected identities using owner+kind+immutable local payload+capture/ACK linkage and causal order. Never parse actual ID strings or discard IDs. Require uniqueness where claimed; preserve unresolved peer payload alternatives rather than guessing. Current actual source/digest/union/lifecycle guards still run independently.
rolling_follow_on.what_can_run_before_complete_hidden_cove: A clearly labeled heuristic can retain a conditional model estimate for ranking. It may test actual observed physical/source facts and abstain on contradictions, while explicitly leaving unobserved history uncertain. This is not a certified belief set. It must use the same state estimate/filter/cost for every strong method and cannot claim worst-case protection from one assumed state.
rolling_follow_on.minimal_later_experiment: After initial integration, preregister phaseB two unique future preferences from the already accepted model point only when original action prefix and observable correspondence are established. First validate mapping/filter failures against saved actual owner evidence without rerunning native. Then prospective later replan can be studied under its conditional assumptions; old same-action/full-output conformance alone does not authorize that mapping.
